customers.name: Mara Quill
customers.dialogue: My old port's been throwing static for a week. I run packets through the drowned district. I can't afford a dead link mid-route. Put a bridge in. Clean.

scan_findings.head: Cortex activity normal. Mild stress pattern.
scan_findings.neck: Fibrous mass wrapped around an old port seat.
scan_findings.spine: Relay intact. Signal attenuated at C2.

customers.name: Dez Okafor
customers.dialogue: Pushed my rig too hard on a job. Smelled something burning, and it wasn't the coffee. I need a new bridge before my client notices I'm offline.

scan_findings.head: Residual feedback echo in motor cortex.
scan_findings.neck: Charred contacts and carbon scoring in the cavity.
scan_findings.spine: Relay intact. Heat stress on outer sheath.

customers.name: Hollis Brandt
customers.dialogue: Union says I need a link to keep running the new cranes. Never had chrome in my life. Doc... go easy, yeah? I don't do well with needles.

scan_findings.head: Age-typical cortex. No prior implants.
scan_findings.neck: Old work injury. Thick scar tissue at the port site.

customers.name: Juno Reyes
customers.dialogue: Got a bridge from a street clinic last year. Now my hands go numb and I hear dial tones. Rip it out and put in something that doesn't hate me.

scan_findings.head: Inflammation markers along synthetic nerve paths.
scan_findings.neck: Swollen tissue around a cheap implant housing.
scan_findings.spine: Immune activity at the relay junction.
